question.text: Under Section 35 of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act 1967, which authority has the power to add or remove an organization from the First Schedule of terrorist organizations?

answer.text: The Central Government, by notification in the Official Gazette
The Securities and Exchange Board of India

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 35 of UAPA empowers the Central Government, by notification in the Official Gazette, to add, remove, or amend organisations in the First Schedule (list of terrorist organisations). The Trap: RBI, SEBI, and FIU-IND have roles in AML/CFT implementation but do NOT have the power to designate terrorist organisations under Section 35 — that is a Central Government function. Note: The Central Government's notification power under Section 35 is the only point directly grounded in the checked workbook page.
